metadata.description: Name of the data collection rule.
Must be the same region as the Log Analytics workspace and the DCE.
Resource ID of the target Log Analytics workspace.
Optional. Resource ID of a Data Collection Endpoint. Leave empty to use the DCR built-in ingestion endpoint.

properties.description: Normalizes NXLog Windows security events into SecurityEvent, Logstash syslog into Syslog, and CEF into CommonSecurityLog.
